piezime:
Lists are in the public annex file: annex 11 (27 assembly points, LKS-92 TM coordinates) and annex 13 (21 accommodation sites, no coordinates). The assembly table has no name column, so nosaukums is the 'Teritoriālā vienība' value; coordinates are written northing first then easting (e.g. '272785.66
728672.57'), stored as lat=first (y), lon=second (x). The 'Iedzīvotāju skaits' column is population served, not capacity, so it is kept in piezime. Gultas 'nav' recorded as 0.
